parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client-generated token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate a unique token for the request. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- `zh`: Chinese.

- `en`: English.

Default value: `en`.

parameters.name: UserClientIp
parameters.description: The IP address of the client.

parameters.name: Vpcs
parameters.description:
The VPCs.

> If you leave this parameter empty, all VPCs bound to the zone are unbound.

sub_parameters.name: RegionId
sub_parameters.description: The ID of the region where the VPC is located.

sub_parameters.name: VpcType
sub_parameters.description:
The type of the VPC. Valid values:

- **STANDARD**: a standard VPC.

- **EDS**: an Elastic Desktop Service VPC.

parameters.name: ZoneId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the zone.
